authority: User confirmed Layout-first, six queues, one waiting packet per stream, journey/criterion reporting; final direction: less testing and more moving.
status: Effective source-first phase: serial source integration, cached combined compile before package; application tests/browser qualification/consolidated Sol review later. No per-child approval chain or base-confirmation wait.

luna-medium.role: default bounded implementation or evidence collection

astra-debug.role: evidence-led behavioral bug diagnosis and repair

astra-deep-debug.role: difficult unresolved bug diagnosis and repair

sol-review.role: independent contract/source/evidence Standards and Spec review

packet_rules.low_is_packet_only: No whole multi-behavior task is assigned Low; coordinator may extract mechanical subpackets with exact oracle and no new lifecycle/identity policy.
packet_rules.high_parent_can_split: Rendering/mechanical subpackets can use Medium/Low after concrete state contract and ownership are proven; record packet-level override and reason.
packet_rules.same_crate_proof: INT.1 must prove actual private consumer/provider reachability before parallel feature dispatch.
packet_rules.acceptance: All packet outcomes/checks plus real joins remain required to close the parent.

review_rules.batching: Default: one integrated candidate receives consolidated Standards+Spec review and paired browser journeys. Reviewers split the candidate by workflow/file ownership in parallel and return one actionable finding list.
review_rules.dedicated: Routine and necessary API/design changes proceed under user authority to candidate review. Escalate only a concrete unresolved requirement that prevents meaningful implementation, not a blanket API permission gate.
review_rules.preimplementation: Authors refine specs/tickets and implement immediately from pinned React behavior and proven consumed capabilities; routine frontend slices do not wait for an independent planning approval.
review_rules.repair_independence: If any reviewer/debugger edits a repair, a different Sol reviewer assesses the exact integrated delta.
review_rules.extra_high: New reviews use Sol 6.1 High, including focused unresolved review. Astra xhigh remains available for difficult evidenced bug repair, not default review.
review_rules.scope_upgrade: Record discovered ownership/async/gesture risks and add discriminating focused tests; include them in the candidate review rather than opening another approval queue.
review_rules.evidence_freshness: Pin one candidate commit/build/fixture manifest; reuse source and test evidence when unchanged. Recheck only affected behavior after repairs. Preserve unresolved defects and accurate unexecuted gates.
review_rules.contract_reuse: Reuse applicable contracts. No mandatory independent planning→source→root-composition sequence for routine frontend work.

escalation.mechanical_errors: Author may fix obvious compiler/type/format errors normally; recurring failure with no new evidence triggers diagnosis.
escalation.behavioral_regression: Retain failing public reproduction and candidate; Astra High diagnoses/fixes instead of repeated speculative Luna rewrites.
escalation.high_to_xhigh: Escalate unresolved material reasoning/bug with prior hypotheses and evidence.
escalation.approval_boundaries: Necessary migration APIs/design changes authorized by latest user instruction; unrelated destructive/history/external cutover actions retain their separate authority.

steady_state: six persistent Luna workbench author lanes with disjoint private ownership
independent Sol 6.1 High Standards and Spec review axes
optional Luna automatic-frontier planner within remaining capacity
concurrency.three_builders: Historical three-author proposal superseded by six persistent workbench streams; simultaneous dispatch bounded by actual capacity and review/verification queues.
concurrency.shared_files: coordinator serializes; browser sessions/stores isolated; CAD-heavy checks serial
concurrency.runtime_change: User/configured ceiling30; collaboration metadata exposes11 total slots. Actual spawn rejection remains binding; queue or reuse suitable agents. No host configuration changed.
concurrency.heavy_jobs: Coordinator grants target-specific leases; at most two active heavy jobs, including at most one package build. No process-list-based self-dispatch.

runtime_observation.effective_child_tier: unverified unless runtime metadata reports it
runtime_observation.running_agent_model_changes: Policy updates do not hot-switch launched agents; followup_task has no profile override. Reuse suitable launched profiles or spawn explicit replacement when capacity permits.

calibration: After first accepted tranche, record first-pass acceptance, defect categories, retry/review time and observed usage; adjust bounded packet size/effort without weakening gates.

integration_process.build_window: Freeze root integration inputs through before/after source hashes; isolated authors continue.
integration_process.provider_reuse_spec: specs/page-only-packaging-reuse.md; implemented and actual changed-source qualified at19525578
integration_process.acceptance: One integrated Standards/Spec candidate review with affected paired journeys. All parent criteria remain; no per-child approval chain.

api_design_authority.user_instruction: if you need to change things (APIs, design) change them
api_design_authority.scope: Necessary migration API/design/visibility/contracts changes; no repeated permission round
requirements: compatibility or verified migration for saved projects

testing_policy.ordinary_ui: Required affected check on combined source; no new test by default.
testing_policy.bug_fix: Reuse actual reproduction, focused regression and affected verification.
testing_policy.candidate: One consolidated Sol review and changed paired journeys; reuse unchanged evidence.
testing_policy.broaden: Only a failure or identified unresolved risk justifies more checks.
testing_policy.parent_gates: All62 acceptance criteria and RF history retained.

skill_overrides.planning: Refine existing specs/tickets; no repeat quiz or duplicate publication.
skill_overrides.implementation: Existing integration branch; direct serial coordinator joins; ordinary UI has no TDD or separate merger requirement.
skill_overrides.review: One finalized candidate review; parent decisions reference it.
skill_overrides.records: Coordinator owns parent/live/RF updates; derived views refresh through progress.py sync.

execution_phase.source_base: Reuse assigned relevant base unless consumed interfaces or overlapping source change; no confirmation wait.
execution_phase.continuation: Original author automatically continues distinct real gaps in its ownership after joining.
execution_phase.no_gap_audit: Return existing source pointers by message; no new receipt, commit or worktree.
execution_phase.compiler: One combined diagnostic list; fix existing source without duplicating specs/tickets/reviews; compile before package retry.
execution_phase.qualification: No new application tests/browser/reviews in current integration phase. Source presence and compilation are not acceptance.
